item.title: Why I Quit Without Quitting
item.description:
An interesting story about broken ideals and dusted promises. A goodbye (?) letter, to UniUD.

OK cool, context?

Back in 2022, I obtained my diploma in Telecommunications and Computer Science in High School, after 2.5 years of COVID pandemic and lockdowns, I left high school, ready to crash uni, fulfilled with the desire of meeting an enormous amount of clever and smart people and to let them inspire me and to grow together with them.
